name: I Became the Lich Lord of the Zombie Apocalypse
source:
Two years after the dead got up, the protagonist lives in a bunker run by Dan, who has the locks, the food and the gun. Kelly gets the good blanket, Jade fixes whatever breaks, and he gets the mop and every trip outside. When a supply run goes wrong and the door stays shut behind him, he is left bitten and alone beside a crashed medical truck, and drinks something he shouldn't have. He wakes before an empty throne, where a crowned witch calls him a candidate.

[From [url=https://bonecrownstudio.itch.io/lich-lord-zombie-apocalypse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
死人复生两年后，男主角住进了一座由丹掌管的地堡——钥匙、食物和枪全攥在丹手里。凯莉分到了好毛毯，杰德负责修补坏掉的物件，而男主角分到的只有一把拖把，以及每一次外出搜刮物资的苦差事。直到一次搜集物资的行动出了岔子，地堡大门在他身后死死紧闭，被丧尸咬伤的他孤身一人被困在一辆撞毁的医疗车旁，喝下了本不该喝的东西。再次醒来时，他已置身于一座空置的王座前，一位头戴王冠的女巫称他为“候补者”。

[摘自[url=https://bonecrownstudio.itch.io/lich-lord-zombie-apocalypse]itch.io[/url]]
